sample_read: Slurm job 919175 read one epoched EEGLAB SET/FDT pair from each of study01-study05 and confirmed finite first-epoch values.
notes: The release contains 59 SET, 59 FDT, 59 block_dt MAT and one TXT file (178 total).
Native study samples have 80-89 channels and 100, 200 or 256 Hz sampling; they must not be silently pooled.
No verified clean EEG target exists, so this dataset is evaluation-only unless a separate compatible prior transfer is registered.
